bundlingNotes: General Rule F states explicitly: 'The rates set forth herein do not include any charge made for title search, title examination, closing, or escrow services performed by the Insurer, or any of its approved attorneys or agents. Charges made for such services are in addition to the rates and charges set forth herein.' Confirms MI premium/settlement-fee separation, but FNTI's manual itself prices premium only -- no settlement/escrow dollar figures given. Note: the manual's own Applicability clause (Section A) contains a copy/paste artifact stating rates are 'specifically for land located in Alabama,' despite the document being titled and filed for Michigan throughout (MI county-code table, MI-specific endorsement codes MI213-MI245) -- an apparent template error in FNTI's own filing, not a wrong-state document.

provider: Modern Title Group (Ann Arbor, MI independent title/settlement company)
scenario: $500,000 purchase price, residential resale, buyer-side and seller-side breakdowns (this calculator prices off sale price only; it has no loan-amount input, so the $400,000 loan amount in the standard scenario does not affect its output). No county/city selector in this tool -- Modern Title Group is headquartered in Ann Arbor, Washtenaw County, MI and the calculator's formula is presented as a single statewide schedule, not county-tiered.
methodology: Not a server-side calculator -- Modern Title Group's own /js/views/rateCalculator.js (a Vue 3 component fetched via plain HTTP GET, no JS execution needed) contains the complete calculation logic and all fee constants hardcoded client-side: a tiered per-thousand title-insurance-premium formula (separate buyer/seller/refi base rates and marginal rates) plus 6 flat ancillary fees per transaction side. Recomputed by hand from the fetched JS source for the $500,000 scenario -- these are Modern Title Group's own published figures, not a third-party rate-table clone (contrast with the out-of-scope alphaadv.net-style aggregators already logged in CALCULATORS.md). The same page also embeds a Qualia Connect widget (connect.qualia.com/quote-widget, token bAQ2Tvo7Bsxa39R5j-style embed) and links to a moderntitlegroup.titlecapture.com/title-quote page -- both are separate JS-only quoting systems for the same company, logged separately in CALCULATORS.md as jsOnly.
